estimates.assumptions: Standard sesame seed hamburger buns weigh ~75g each; 2 buns total 150g edible portion. Typical value for similar buns.
'Chopped' onion in Big Mac context is a modest amount for 4 burgers; ~40g total chopped white onion is realistic. CaloriesPer100g copied from supplied known value.
1/4 of a typical medium-large iceberg lettuce head (~340g whole) yields ~85g shredded edible portion. CaloriesPer100g copied from supplied known value.
2 slices American-style cheese for the recipe; each slice ~20g. Typical calorie density for processed burger cheese.
2 large dill pickles sliced for 4 burgers total ~60g edible weight. CaloriesPer100g copied from supplied known value.
1 cup mayonnaise weighs ~220g. CaloriesPer100g copied from supplied known value.
A pinch of pepper is a very small amount (~0.5-1g); using 1g as modest estimate. CaloriesPer100g copied from supplied known value.
1.5 tsp onion salt weighs ~7-9g (salt-based seasoning); using 7g. Typical calorie density for onion salt.
